limitations: Three-second horizon completion right-censors later stops and cannot prove improved historical stopping.
Two repeats per arm provide no frequency estimate; fixed arm order and unchanged hidden worker fields limit attribution.
Previous-end warmstart seeds are heuristics at changed initial states; production equivalence and a unique historical cause remain unproven.
Execution approval is separate. No capture was performed by this reviewer.
rationale: Verified clean exact HEAD, matching packet/manifest hashes and all 61 sealed member hashes.
Protocol, native warmstart patch and ownership helper are byte-identical to the previously reviewed version. Binary hash remains b161f969ca5d8e48c7cc3fc7ab98b4e9c93d94b0d67fa721acf1ba4bfef45fef.
Prior conclusions about nominal rollout initialization before FD, complete trajectory copying and reset/retained-history semantics remain applicable.
Contact comparisons now use order-insensitive sets. Unobserved saturation times have explicit censoring labels and a null timing gap rather than an observed zero gap.
Target-scoped CMake and durable request/reservation accounting repairs preserve the scientific intervention, four-process matrix, physical conditions, thresholds, budget and no-retry rule.
